diff: +- **HINGE** — a premise of one of the five programme statuses (OPEN, CITED, DISCHARGED, WITNESSED, REFUTED-BY-COMPUTATION) whose consumers lie in more than one kernel, or in more than one chain within a kernel, the chains taken after the premise's own evidence is removed from the use-graph: every declaration whose statement is the premise's satisfiability (a Salt witness), its negation (a not_ refutation) or a projection of it; a premise of status DOMAIN, a Mathlib predicate restricting a quantified variable, is printed with its chains and is not a hinge *(the author's ruling (R254)(4), superseding the entry above from 2026-10-09)*
